verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities. Sift has Workflows, a rules automation platform for real-time risk decisions (sift-docs-12, sift-docs-6). It also has a Decisions API and custom Decisions such as Ban Account, which let a business programmatically record block actions against users or events (sift-docs-3, sift-docs-7). Nothing documents dedicated allow/block lists keyed on emails, cards, devices or IPs, and nothing documents configurable velocity limits, so this is glancing support at best. Missing for 10: explicit allow/block list management per entity type (email, card, device, IP), velocity-limit configuration, documented dashboard UI for list management, a list-management API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
